verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.01 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2018 (90% interval −0.05 to +0.06). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 57 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.95). Counted by gap size instead, 18 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.31). But: only 14 clear observation periods before the event (need 20); the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.03 vs typical 0.00).
